title: A Locker for the Prom
author: Jude Halloran
blurb: Jude Villalobos, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before the last game of the season.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
